purpose: Versioned external-source register for the non-normative Caelestis standards-alignment audit. Access status states what was reviewed; it is not an adoption or compliance assertion.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 — Artificial intelligence management system
sources.reviewed_material: ISO public record and abstract; not the licensed full text.
sources.audit_use: Management-system, documented-process, lifecycle and continual-improvement comparison only.
sources.limit: No clause-level ISO 42001 conformity assessment is made.

sources.reviewed_material: ISO public record and abstract; not the licensed full text.

sources.title: ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42 — Artificial intelligence standards programme
sources.limit: The catalogue is not a substitute for individual standard texts.

sources.title: NIST AI 100-1 — Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

sources.audit_use: Govern, Map, Measure and Manage outcome comparison.

sources.title: Singapore Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI
sources.publisher: Infocomm Media Development Authority of Singapore
sources.reviewed_material: Published framework, IMDA launch material and updated framework notice.
sources.audit_use: Agent lifecycle, technical controls, human accountability, user responsibility and escalation comparison.
sources.limit: This is comparative governance guidance, not a CAM adoption or Singapore compliance claim.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act)
sources.reviewed_material: Official legal text; bounded crosswalk only.
sources.audit_use: Documentation, logging, oversight, accuracy/robustness/cybersecurity, post-market and actor-accountability orientation.
sources.limit: This audit does not determine legal applicability, conformity, provider/deployer status, or EU AI Act compliance.

sources.title: Humanoid robot full-lifecycle identity reporting (comparative case)
sources.reviewed_material: Public summary reporting; a primary technical standard or registry specification was not available for review.
